title: Why You Can’t Let Go (And What It’s Teaching You) | What About the World
fullTitle: Soul Feast #94: Why You Can’t Let Go (And What It’s Teaching You) | What About the World

promo.text: Are you ready to live Beyond the Five Sense? Learn how HERE.

description: In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav turns to a subject humanity has wrestled with for millennia: attachment. For thousands of years, teachings like the Buddha’s Four Noble Truths named desire as the root of suffering, but Gary reexamines this wisdom through the new multisensory consciousness now emerging in the species, revealing a more precise picture of where attachment comes from.
Using the framework of loving and frightened parts of your personality:
Gary traces attachment to a single source: a frightened part of your personality, which reaches toward the earth rather than the soul.

This attachment is not just emotionally uncomfortable but physically painful , felt in the body’s energy centers, and acting on it – through anger, judgment, or compulsion – only deepens the attachment from which it springs.

The solution lies in reframing attachment not as an enemy but a teacher: it reveals exactly which parts of the personality block love, giving each person the raw material to consciously choose love over fear and build authentic power.
What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast

(00:02) — Why the Buddha’s ancient teaching that desire causes suffering requires updating for a multisensory species, and how the new understanding of power reframes the entire conversation around attachment.
(05:56) — Tracing attachment to the frightened parts of personality that reach toward the earth , while the loving parts reach toward the soul.
(08:52) — Why acting on attachment always creates painful consequences , and how anger’s magnetic pull becomes a doorway into deeper self-understanding.
(18:06) — Unpacking the pain of powerlessness and not belonging , including how the idea of “original sin” is exposed as a fear-based fantasy rather than truth.
(21:07) — How attachment ultimately points to exactly the parts of personality to move beyond the control of in order to create authentic power.
(24:13) — Closing with the recognition that everything, including attachment, serves the purpose of spiritual growth , and a Soul Step for tracking what resonates throughout the week.

This week, notice the moments when something won’t let you go – a thought you can’t stop returning to, a feeling you can’t shake, a pull you can’t explain. Instead of masking it or acting on it right away, pause and ask yourself: what part of my personality is this coming from, and what is it trying to show me? Write down what you notice, whether the answer is uncomfortable or clarifying. You are not here to eliminate attachment overnight – you are here to see it clearly.
